english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for restricting or slowing progress, development, or ideas.
Use this more formal or written verb when stressing an obstacle to progress or development.

examples.english: The company's layers of approval stultify our efforts to launch the new project.
examples.traditional: 公司層層審批，阻礙咗我哋推行新計劃。
